recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Future SearchParameter subset policy should wait for a resolved/applied issue such as FHIR-53907 or successor work; do not use FHIR-13711 to undo FHIR-51587.
issue_request: FHIR-13711 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 request to document a limited reusable subset of FHIRPath for discriminator, SearchParameter, DataRequirement, and related path-expression usages instead of duplicating local subset descriptions.
initial_application: SVN revision 13384, now git commit 09da6b23175e728a561c9bbf1d02403af87fc1ca, explicitly applied GF#13711 by adding Simple FHIRPath subset links to DataRequirement path comments, ElementDefinition.slicing.discriminator.path, OperationOutcome.issue.expression, and documentation navigation. The current source has since folded that separate page into source/fhirpath.html#simple.
additional_context: Later related work refined the original scope: FHIR-13718 completed DataRequirement filter wording, FHIR-19612 audited discriminator references to fhirpath.html#simple, and FHIR-51587 is the controlling applied SearchParameter decision because FHIR-I reopened a simple-subset proposal and approved full-FHIRPath guidance with resolve()/chaining cautions. FHIR-53907 requests future SHOULD-level SearchParameter subset guidance but remains Triaged/Unresolved.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit is needed because the restricted subset is centrally documented, discriminator/DataRequirement/OperationOutcome consumers point to it, and changing SearchParameter.expression to the Simple FHIRPath subset would conflict with later applied FHIR-51587 guidance.
